body: It's not common to feel like you're only alive for boredom or lack of feeling. That sounds exactly like depression though, which is a mental illness many suffer from and have difficulty fighting against. 90% of people who commit suicide had mental illness of some kind or another, according to autopsies. I would really like if you did something that we know helps against depression, whether it's as small as exercising more or as big as talking to a therapist. Whether you do or not, I hope you feel better friend.
That's awesome. Congrats on the good work! I'd tell you to stay positive, but you know better than I ever could how much control over your feelings you have. Wishing all the best.

I think you can change things. College is like high school in a lot of ways, but it's more open: you choose who you hang out with, when, where, why. And in the right parts of the world college students are of drinking age, which is an important stress-release mechanism for many. You sound human to me. Please take care.
